title: 第115章 清单上多了一条
slug: 我一值夜班全院主任都睡不着
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周四傍晚，林野重新走进急诊的时候，护士站墙上多了一张纸。

A4纸，用透明胶带贴在原来那张高危预警清单旁边。上面只有一行手写字，是周敏的笔迹。

“留观/检查患者离开后未按时返回，十五分钟内确认去向。”

林野站在那看了两秒。

这两天他没来医院，但这张纸让他知道，吴德明那件事已经变成了一条制度。

赵护士从他背后经过，顺着他的目光也看了一眼那张纸。

“看见了？前天你走以后加的。”

“吴德明那个事？”

“对。周敏贴的，说以后谁出去做检查，回来了没有得有人看着。不回来就找，找不着就报上去。就多看一眼的事。”

林野点了下头。

“他后来怎么样了？”

赵护士拧开保温杯喝了一口。

“血管通了一部分，但有一段肠子没保住，切了。人还在重症躺着呢，没完全过来。”

切了一截肠子。

赵护士看他脸色不太好，又说了一句。

“对了，他老伴来护士站找过你，说要当面谢你。白班护士跟她说你休息不在，她留了个电话号码，夹在交班本最后一页。”

“谢我什么。”

“你那天不是跑回来帮着推了一截嘛。”赵护士把杯盖拧回去，“老太太就认这个，觉得你来了她老伴才没事。你跟她解释也没用。”

他不觉得自己做了什么值得被谢的事。人是马昊找到的，血糖是马昊测的，补糖是周敏下的令，增强CT是白班上级开的。他全程就提供了一个时间点，帮着推了一截平车。

但他也知道，如果那天周敏没打那个电话，如果他没跑回来，事情会不会拖得更久。

想不清楚。不想了。

赵护士看他站在那不动，拿保温杯底碰了一下他胳膊。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

On Thursday evening, when Lin Ye walked into the emergency room again, there was an extra piece of paper on the wall of the nurse station.

A4 paper, taped with transparent tape next to the original high-risk warning list.There is only one line of handwriting on it, which is Zhou Min's handwriting.

"Observe/check if the patient fails to return on time after leaving, and confirm the whereabouts within fifteen minutes."

Lin Ye stood there and stared for two seconds.

He didn't come to the hospital for the past two days, but this piece of paper let him know that Wu Deming's incident had become a system.

Nurse Zhao passed behind him and followed his gaze and glanced at the paper.

"Did you see it? It was added after you left the day before yesterday."

"What about Wu Deming?"

"Yes. Zhou Min posted it, saying that no one will be watching anyone who goes out for a check-up in the future. If they don't come back, they will look for them. If they can't find them, they will report them. It's just a matter of taking one more look."

Lin Ye nodded.

"What happened to him?"

Nurse Zhao unscrewed the thermos cup and took a sip.

"The blood vessels were partially opened, but a section of the intestine was not saved and had to be cut off. The person is still lying in a critical condition and has not fully recovered."

Cut off a piece of intestine.

Nurse Zhao saw that his face was not very good, so she said something else.

"By the way, his wife came to the nursing station to find you and said she wanted to thank you in person. The day shift nurse told her that you were away during the break, so she left a phone number on the last page of the shift book."

"Thank me for nothing."

"Didn't you come back that day and help push it a bit." Nurse Zhao screwed the lid back on the cup, "The old lady just accepts this and thinks that her wife will be fine only if you are here. It's useless for you to explain to her."

He didn't feel like he had done anything worthy of being thanked.The person was found by Ma Hao, the blood sugar was measured by Ma Hao, the sugar supplement was ordered by Zhou Min, and the enhanced CT was prescribed by the superior during the day shift.He provided a time point throughout the entire process and helped push a flat cart.

But he also knew that if Zhou Min hadn't made that call that day, if he hadn't run back, things would have dragged on even longer.

Can't think clearly.Don’t think about it anymore.

Nurse Zhao saw him standing there motionless and touched his arm with the bottom of the thermos cup.
